text: My own estimate still points to C (about 55%): China and India alone are roughly 37% of the ~5.9 billion people in 1997, and Indonesia, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nigeria, Vietnam, and others push the total higher. The team note's options (40% or 25%) conflict with that arithmetic, and I can't check the World Bank report from here, so the note should be verified against the source before anyone relies on it. CONFIDENCE: 45
